job: 5549 S Lansing Ct — elevated deck, 8' x 12' at 10' (TimberTech Reserve Driftwood, IRX bronze)
notes: Owner plan (Oct 2026): a new second-story deck off the existing door, 8' along the house x 12' out, surface 10' above the backyard. Replaces the smaller existing deck in the photos (two posts on concrete pads), which is demo'd. The ledger lands on a cantilevered floor (the floor framing overhangs the foundation wall), so the attachment and the lateral load path are engineered: GSX provides the engineer. Frame: TrueFrame by ProWood #1 SYP 2x10 joists at 16" OC, double rims hung in HUCQ210-2, one row of blocking over the beam. One drop beam, (2)4x10 Douglas fir #1 (two 4x10 plies, through-bolted), 2' back from the front rim face, on only (2) 6x6 DF #1 posts on Diamond Piers. Decking TimberTech Reserve Driftwood, CONCEALoc hidden fasteners, single picture frame on the 3 open sides (none against the house), Driftwood fascia; G-Tape on the joists, rims and beam. Rail: TimberTech Impression Rail Express (IRX), vertical square aluminum balusters, modern top rail, Bronze, 36", on the left, right and front. No stairs (none in the photos or the plan).

easements: Check plat R1535678 for rear / side utility and drainage easements
